close_reason: Fixed in next commit. PLACEHOLDER_ID extracted to pub(crate) const in src/helpers.rs, sibling to PLACEHOLDER_BLOB_ID. All 6 literal sites (5 write + 1 read) converted. Visibility deferred to pub(crate) rather than pub per the bead's caution about public-API stability commitment. cargo test, clippy, fmt all clean. Sibling-propagation notes left on q2wa.7.1-.7.7.
description:
src/backend.rs:64-87 (`MailBackend::create_object` doc) documents the sentinel contract:

> - **`id`**: The `id` field in the input object is always set to
>   `"placeholder"`. The backend MUST replace it with a real, unique,
>   account-scoped ID and return that ID as the first element of the
>   result tuple.

The string `"placeholder"` is hardcoded as a literal at src/email.rs:1685:

```
let mut email = Email::new(
    Id::from("placeholder"),  // ← literal, not a constant
    blob_id,                  // ← uses crate::helpers::PLACEHOLDER_BLOB_ID
    ...
);
```

…and at sibling sentinel sites (Mailbox/set create, Identity/set create, etc.).

Contrast with `PLACEHOLDER_BLOB_ID` at src/helpers.rs:19 which IS a `pub(crate) const` used at email.rs:1681 to fill the same role for `blob_id`.

Contract issue: the `MailBackend::create_object` docstring promises backends a specific sentinel value (`"placeholder"`), but the value is encoded only as a literal. A future rename (e.g. to namespace-collide-proof `__jmap_placeholder_id__`) is a coordinated multi-site edit, and any backend that wants to detect-and-replace the sentinel must hardcode the same literal — drifting from any future rename.

This is a sibling of JMAP-q2wa.5 (which addresses the `placeholder-blob` literal drift in memory.rs). The fix is symmetric: extract a `PLACEHOLDER_ID` constant alongside `PLACEHOLDER_BLOB_ID` and use it at every sentinel write site.

Stronger fix: expose `PLACEHOLDER_ID` and `PLACEHOLDER_BLOB_ID` as `pub const` (not `pub(crate)`) so backends can use them in their own `create_object` impls — e.g.:

```
fn create_object<O: SetObject>(&self, ..., obj: O) -> ... {
    if obj.id().as_ref() == jmap_mail_server::PLACEHOLDER_ID {
        // generate real id
    }
}
```

…rather than every backend hardcoding `== "placeholder"` and risking drift.

Priority P3 because: the docstring contract is currently clear enough to a careful reader, and this is a maintenance-burden / future-rename issue rather than an active bug. But if the constants get publicly exposed in a future minor and any consumer takes a dependency on them, the contract becomes stable forever — so this decision should be made deliberately.

Cookie-cutter amplification: every sibling extension-server crate has the same sentinel pattern. Suggested cross-check.
title: Sentinel id 'placeholder' is a string literal, no public/crate constant
